name: selection-demo
notes: The worked selector cookbook (ADR-0042 / D1). One fitted selector on the train split, then a two-estimator sweep that consumes `$select.features` — owner flow 1. Flow 3 is this document with the selector's method treated as a stated choice rather than a given. Flow 2 (a space over the selector's OWN knobs AND `model.estimator`) is the same graph with one more space key; it plans because ADR-0044 narrowed the fitted-transform guard to the family's three leakage knobs. `noise` is constant by construction, so the variance threshold must drop it and the winner must never see it. Both candidates are deterministic (LinearRegression / Ridge): RandomForest is the doorway's other usual pair, but a mixed sweep cannot carry `seed`, and an unseeded forest would make 'the winner beat the loser' a flake. Run: python -m dskit.pipeline run examples/pipeline/selection-demo.json --asof 2026-01-01

dataset.notes: The model-sweep market, so the cut and the metric mean the same thing here as there. Swap the source; move the three split instants with it.

noisy.notes: A column with no variance. The selector's job is to drop it. Declaring it on the model instead of `$select.features` is the refusal the suite pins.

select.notes: Learns on the train split only — the family's rule, inherited. The surviving list is an artifact and an output, because no document can name it in advance.

train_rows.notes: SklearnFit fits exactly what is wired in. Without this cut the sweep would select in-sample. Same node, same reason as model-sweep.json.

model.notes: The base pass is Ridge so a reader can see the winner is not just the typed-in estimator. `features` is a reference, not a list: which columns survived is the fit's answer.

validate.notes: Val only. squared_error is the documented exception for unclipped regressor `predict` (see model-sweep.json); brier would refuse an out-of-[0,1] belief.

sweep.notes: Flow 1: selector fixed, space over the doorway. Flow 2 is this block with `select.selector` (or `select.selector_params.threshold`) added beside `model.estimator`.

report.notes: Downstream of the search, so `loss` is the winner's val loss, not the base pass's.

splits.notes: Days 1072 / 1087 / 1103, the model-sweep cut. Test is reserved and unread.
